verdict.rationale: Multi-agent orchestration is a fair question for an AI agent platform like AnythingLLM, so the axis applies. The pack documents only a single @agent surface per chat session. Agent Flows and custom skills extend what that one agent can do, and the docs explicitly do not describe multiple agents, subagents, swarms, or an agent-to-agent protocol for splitting or parallelizing work.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can work together — subagents, swarms, or an agent-to-agent protocol that splits and parallelizes real work
